 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath

Order:

entities.text: Gangasani Damodar Reddy, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the 3rd Respondent in removing the names of the petitioners from the list of villagers of Banda Ravipakula Village, Revalli Mandal,
Wanaparthy District pertaining to payment of compensation for the lands acquired for the purpose of Edula Reservoir Project and further action of the respondents in not taking any action on the representations made by the petitioners dated 28.04.2023 for payment of compensation individually to the petitioners towards the lands and residential houses acquired for the purpose of Edula Reservior Project as highly illegal, arbitrary and in violation of principles of natural justice and contrary to the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013..."

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard Learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.
With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.

3. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that the respondents will consider the SK,J representation dated 28.04.2023 filed by the petitioners and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

4. In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioners on 28.04.2023 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law within eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date: 13.03.2024 spk Gangasani Damodar Reddy, vs The State Of Telangana, on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50879913/
